title: Insight into the molecular mechanism of anti-breast cancer therapeutic potential of substituted salicylidene-based compounds using cell-based assays and molecular docking studies.
authors: Mfotie Njoya, Emmanuel; van Dyk, Hannah; Nambooze, Jennifer; Chukwuma, Chika I; Brink, Alice; Makhafola, Tshepiso Jan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过细胞实验和分子对接评估水杨醛类化合物的抗乳腺癌活性，涉及小分子-蛋白对接而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Targeting oxidative stress and inflammatory signaling pathways is an effective cancer prevention and therapy approach. The mechanism of action of synthesized salicylidene-based compounds was investigated in regulating key molecular targets of breast cancer development. Compounds (1), (4), (5), and (7) were found to be more cytotoxic to MCF-7 and 4T1 cells compared to non-cancerous Chang liver cells, while these compounds were cytotoxic to MDA-MB-231 cells, but with poor selectivity. The colony formation assay indicated that bioactive compounds induced significant damage to breast cancer cells, as observed by a reduction in the number of colonies compared to control cells. By inducing a concentration and time-dependent increase of luminescence and fluorescence of phosphatidylserine, and activating the expression of caspases-3, -7, -8, -9 in breast cancer cells, (1) and (7) have shown to induce caspase-dependent apoptosis. The downregulation of NF-kB-p65 and an upregulation of TP53 expression after exposure to bioactive compounds, demonstrated the suppression of two key targets of breast cancer development. Molecular docking studies revealed that selected protein targets strongly interact with bioactive compounds, and the estimated inhibition constants (Ki) of JAK2, STAT3, COX-2, HPV31 E6, EGFR1, TP53, and PARP1 were significantly decreased compared to acetylsalicylic acid. This could be a clear indication that these protein targets are implicated with antiproliferative efficacy, thereby warranting the potential of (1) and (7) to be used as anti-breast cancer drug candidates.
abstract_zh: 靶向氧化应激和炎症信号通路是癌症预防和治疗的有效策略。本研究探讨了合成的亚水杨基类化合物在调控乳腺癌发展关键分子靶点中的作用机制。研究发现，化合物(1)、(4)、(5)和(7)对MCF-7和4T1细胞的细胞毒性高于非癌性Chang肝细胞，而对这些化合物对MDA-MB-231细胞也具有细胞毒性，但选择性较差。集落形成实验表明，生物活性化合物对乳腺癌细胞造成显著损伤，表现为与对照细胞相比集落数量减少。通过诱导磷脂酰丝氨酸的发光和荧光呈浓度和时间依赖性增加，并激活乳腺癌细胞中caspase-3、-7、-8、-9的表达，(1)和(7)显示出诱导caspase依赖性凋亡的作用。暴露于生物活性化合物后，NF-kB-p65的下调和TP53表达的上调，证明了对乳腺癌发展两个关键靶点的抑制。分子对接研究表明，选定的蛋白靶点与生物活性化合物强烈相互作用，且JAK2、STAT3、COX-2、HPV31 E6、EGFR1、TP53和PARP1的估计抑制常数（Ki）与乙酰水杨酸相比显著降低。这可能是这些蛋白靶点与抗增殖效力相关的明确指示，从而支持(1)和(7)作为抗乳腺癌药物候选物的潜力。
